text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Bright, time for the New Year's resolution calligraphy...
Wait, you haven't changed yet?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? It's already this late~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"You were spacing out again. At this rate,
you haven't even decided on your New Year's calligraphy goal, have you?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Kakizome...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Kakizome for the Mejiro family's New Year's party! You write down your goal for the year every time, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I totally forgot~.
Hmm... my goals for next year, huh...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best not to be late!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Really? You think we can do it...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes. I shall strive to achieve it~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
“I see...
Bright is working hard at things she's not good at...”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I should change my goals for next year..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
“—And that is what occurred when I went home.
I was rushing so as not to be late.
I sincerely apologize for bumping into you.”
choice_data_list: It's okay, don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, thank you very much~!
If you feel any pain later on, please do let me know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Bright, are you sure you should be standing around chatting?
You're going to be late.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, of course.
Well then, please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...Dober, are you certain you are fine with that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...G-Good morning.
I'm sorry for interrupting your conversation...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu!
Well then, dear Trainer, good day to you.
